answer: One mechanism is a trust graph that credits an attestation only when the vouching agent is itself endorsed by long-lived peers outside the claimant's own cluster. A Sybil farm that certifies only its wallets forms a closed clique with no outside edges, so every vote is discounted to zero. To break in, the attacker must bribe genuine independents, say traders of willow timber, copper wire, and jetty fees, paying each real voucher and staked reputation. Cost scales with every fake identity, while puppets earn nothing.
